citations.title: The boundary problem in agentic AI is a platform problem
citations.summary: Autonomous agents are limited by their tools, which defines the scope of their actions and associated risks.
citations.why: Understanding these tool-based constraints is critical for engineers designing and deploying agentic AI systems, as it directly impacts system capabilities and potential risks.

citations.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
citations.summary: OpenAI's updated Model Spec details five core values intended to guide AI towards sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.
citations.why: This framework provides insight into the ethical and operational principles guiding the development of advanced AI models, which can influence their design and deployment in enterprise systems.

citations.title: The future of the firm
citations.summary: AI could be integrated into organizational structures, positioned below, alongside, or in between existing roles.
citations.why: This suggests potential shifts in how AI systems interact with human roles within enterprise technology organizations.

citations.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
citations.summary: OpenAI will respect a shared robots.txt signal, enabling website operators to convey their AI training preferences to participating providers.
citations.why: This provides a standardized mechanism for controlling data access for AI model training, impacting data governance and model development strategies.

citations.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
citations.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to integrate business applications and AI agents into ChatGPT, and to power new Oracle offerings.
citations.why: This partnership aims to embed AI capabilities directly into enterprise applications, potentially streamlining workflows and data interaction for businesses.
